verdict.rationale: Babylon.js exposes a comprehensive, documented public JavaScript/TypeScript API (NPM modules, typedoc class references like NullEngine, ES6 modules, server-side/Node support) that lets any programmatic user, including AI agents, drive scene creation, rendering, and asset import entirely through code rather than a GUI. Community evidence corroborates the API's stability and extensive documentation quality. missing for 10: no explicit machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI probe returned 404s), no dedicated documentation or examples framed around AI/agentic driving of the API, and no independent hands-on evidence of an AI agent successfully automating Babylon.js end-to-end.
